signedOutDevices_one: {{name}} has been signed out on {{count}} device.

canResetOwnTitle: He can reset his own password
canResetOwnBody: He has received a reset code at this email address and used it ({{date}}), so the address reaches him. If he is locked out he can recover on his own.
onlyYouCanResetTitle: Only you can reset his password
onlyYouCanResetBody1: This email address has never been used to receive a reset code, so there is no evidence it reaches him. If he is locked out, he cannot recover on his own - you will have to set a new password for him and tell him what it is.
onlyYouCanResetBody2: If the address is wrong, correcting it does not change this on its own: it counts once he has used a code sent to it.
